title: ResearchPlan
description: A bounded agent's PLAN for how it will attempt a ResearchTask — the ordered steps it intends to take, the access each step needs, and the stop conditions. The plan is a PROPOSAL recorded before execution so the work is traceable and replayable; it does not authorize anything beyond the parent ResearchTask.bounds. Every plan carries the task_id it serves and a step budget that must not exceed the task bound. produces is pinned to source_discovery_report. Deterministic when planned_at is injected.

plan_id.description: content-addressed over (task_id, steps); version in metadata, never in the id

task_id.description: the ResearchTask this plan serves (lineage back-link)

steps.description: the ordered steps the agent intends to take; each is a proposal, not an authorization

action.description: what the step does; none of these serve or promote a fact

target.description: the source/query the step targets (a handle or query string, not a secret)

step_budget.description: must be <= the parent ResearchTask.bounds.max_steps (the proof checks lineage at runtime)

stop_conditions.description: the conditions under which the agent stops; at least one must be present

produces.description: pinned — a plan's execution yields a SourceDiscoveryReport, never a fact
